raw.query: SELECT cr.run_id, cr.denominator_kind, cr.numerator_worker_seconds, cr.denominator_worker_seconds, cr.cost_ratio, cr.denominator_basis, cr.denominator_window_mismatch FROM provenance.v_dim AS d JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio AS cr USING (run_id) WHERE d.is_current = true AND cr.experiment = 'a12' ORDER BY cr.denominator_kind
raw.observed: Both current a12 rows report an unpriced worker-seconds cost_ratio of 0.6034767619719481 (2335019.6 / 3869278.4), with no controller forward cost, tick duty cycle, GPU impact delta, or CPU pricing field.
raw.claimed: GPU impact <0.001x; duty cycle <0.8% at 15 s; priced CPU configurations 0.65-0.66x.
raw.evidence: v_cost_ratio contains only the 0.60348x worker-seconds ratio, so it cannot establish either controller-overhead number or the claimed priced 0.65-0.66x range.
raw.fix: Persist the measured per-tick forward cost, tick count/span, pricing class and resulting charged cost ratio in the owning view, then cite those rows; otherwise qualify these figures as an external calculation.
